response.sql: WITH order_fills AS (SELECT o.recordvault, o.timespan, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fill FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.timespan), timespan_means AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) as timespan_mean FROM order_fills GROUP BY timespan), filtered_orders AS (SELECT of.recordvault, of.timespan, of.avg_fill, of.avg_fill - tm.timespan_mean as excess FROM order_fills of JOIN timespan_means tm ON of.timespan = tm.timespan WHERE of.avg_fill > tm.timespan_mean), ranked_orders AS (SELECT recordvault, timespan, avg_fill, excess, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY timespan ORDER BY avg_fill DESC) as rnk FROM filtered_orders) SELECT recordvault as ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess, rnk FROM ranked_orders WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY timespan, rnk
